dialogues.speaker: Gauhar
dialogues.text: Yes, the contents must be sorted in accordance with the regulations, and the process must also follow regulations.

dialogues.speaker: Gauhar
dialogues.text: Registration, inspection, approval, contracts, secondary approval... Not one step can be skipped.

dialogues.speaker: Gauhar
dialogues.text: If any part of the process is not followed, you have to face the consequences at your own risk.
